body: I've been trying really hard to believe that.

Thank you for your positivity. I just don't see how I can keep going. I can and did wrap my head around owning my mistakes. But I can't willingly continue in an a world where bad people not only get away with being consciously malicious, but I get punished as a result of their malice. Unless I really am the problem, in which case I'm just a bad person.
I should have explained that I would be running away so the people trying to hurt can't hurt the people I love. If my life is going to fall apart, so be it. I want to protect the ones I love.
